caption:
France's inflation slows to 2.9% in November as energy prices fall

Insee says consumer prices fell 0.7% in November, after rising 0.4% in October. Bloomberg reports that inflation in France and Spain slowed much more than anticipated. Easing energy pressures offer some relief to the European Central Bank, which is weighing further interest rate increases. Insee published the French figures on Friday.

Reported by Euronews; Bloomberg.
